architecture.mechanism: Dual-function Pd/CeO2 catalyst adsorbing unburnt hydrocarbons during cold start and promoting oxidation at elevated temperatures
architecture.intervention: Replace the degraded catalytic converter substrate with a Pd/CeO2-based formulation designed to trap hydrocarbons during the extended warm-up period characteristic of turbocharged Hyundai engines, ensuring conversion efficiency once operating temperature is reached.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduction in unburnt hydrocarbon emissions during cold-start phases and prevention of engine performance degradation associated with catalyst light-off delays, resolving the flashing engine light condition under warranty terms.
architecture.falsification_test: Measure tailpipe hydrocarbon concentrations using a standardized cold-start drive cycle (e.g., FTP-75) on a test vehicle equipped with the new Pd/CeO2 converter; failure is confirmed if hydrocarbon levels during the first 100 seconds exceed regulatory limits or match pre-replacement baseline data.
